purpose: Code capabilities observed in the retired regen-refine-session-harness working tree that require an explicit decision before implementation on regen-refine-semantic-base.
excluded: KHeap_R-specific proof guidance and premise-retrieval heuristics
legacy environment, Proof/Support, and M-number lifecycle code

candidates.capability: Reject concurrent runners that would mutate the same theory generation.
candidates.implementation_note: Adapted to one run-level lock because different theories still mutate the same canonical Session Planner ledger. run-session holds the lock for the full serial traversal.

candidates.capability: Recover an Isabelle-GREEN proof after interruption only when its checked source still matches the active graph statement and dependency closure.

Recover the latest interrupted checker attempt and an accepted GRA RETRY_PROOF decision, bind both to the unchanged node statement/dependencies, and consume the decision in exactly the next logical round.
candidates.implementation_note: Recovery is bound to the active graph payload, exact node statement/dependencies, and checker source. RETRY_PROOF is revalidated and rejected after an immutable consumption marker exists.

candidates.capability: Record each runner start/resume with effective harness and budget identity, and provide a read-only status --watch command over the existing persistent monitor files.
Expose GREEN structural analogues and repeated multi-subgoal residuals as evidence that a failed node needs graph revision rather than another unchanged proof round.
Accept RETRY_PROOF only when it supplies a retrieval, outline, frontier, automation-policy, or repair-diagnosis change that differs from the directive already consumed by the current round.
candidates.implementation_note: Every RETRY_PROOF requires a material directive, must differ from the previously consumed directive, and is bound to exactly one subsequent proof round.

candidates.capability: Index deterministic module inputs and outputs by artifact reference, and keep log aggregation operational when an interrupted process leaves an empty or malformed JSON output.
Repair invalid JSON backslashes used by Isabelle symbols without corrupting valid escaped quotes, backslash runs, or Unicode escape sequences.
candidates.implementation_note: Already present in the semantic-base harness with graph-payload identity preserved and dedicated regression tests.
